property_summary: After SetLogFile(addr) with a working log contract, a Deposit by any actor of any amount must succeed (the log's AddMessage is callable); the mutant stores address(0), so every Deposit reverts when it calls AddMessage on the zero address.
change_summary: Replace the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` with `Log = LogFile(address(0));` so the stored Log address is always zero instead of the caller-supplied address.
